steps.analysis: This action depends only on Markor being installed and launchable from the launcher; it can fail if the launch is slow (screen check runs too early) or the app isn't installed, so verify the Markor main screen appeared and retry once before erroring.
steps.snippet:
device.open_app("Markor")
device.settle(2)
on_main = device.find(text="Markor") is not None or \
          device.find(description="Create a new file or folder") is not None
if not on_main:
    device.navigate_home()
    device.settle(1)
    device.open_app("Markor")
    device.settle(3)
    on_main = device.find(text="Markor") is not None or \
              device.find(description="Create a new file or folder") is not None
if not on_main:
    raise RuntimeError("Markor did not launch: app missing or main screen not detected")

steps.analysis: The action depends on locating the note's list item by its content description ("File <name>"), which Markor sets dynamically per file; indexes vary per screen, and the name may not be visible without scrolling.
steps.snippet:
file_name = binding["file_name"]
target = device.find(description="File %s" % file_name, contains=True, clickable=True)
if target is None:
    device.scroll("down")
    target = device.find(description="File %s" % file_name, contains=True, clickable=True)
if target is None:
    raise LookupError("Note item 'File %s' not found on screen" % file_name)
device.long_press(index=target)

steps.analysis: The action clicks the context-menu "Delete" button, which only deletes the *currently selected* note — so it depends on the target note ({file_name}) already being selected, and on the Delete control being findable by its description. On another instance the index differs and the selected note may be wrong, so look the button up by description and guard against deleting a different file.
steps.snippet:
target = binding["file_name"]
if device.find(description=target, contains=True) is None:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Target note '{target}' is not selected/present on screen")
idx = device.find(description="Delete", clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Delete button not found on current screen")
device.click(idx)

steps.analysis: The action is the final confirmation click of Markor's "Confirm Delete" dialog; it depends on that dialog being open with a clickable 'OK' button. On another instance indexes shift and the dialog text/path may differ, so we must locate the dialog by its title/confirmation text containing the note name from `binding` before trusting any 'OK' button.
steps.snippet:
import os

file_name = binding['file_name']
stem = os.path.splitext(file_name)[0]

if device.find(text='Confirm Delete') is None or \
   (device.find(contains=stem) is None and device.find(contains=file_name) is None):
    raise LookupError(f"Delete confirmation dialog for note '{file_name}' not on screen")

idx = device.find(text='OK', clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise LookupError("No clickable 'OK' confirmation button found in delete dialog")

device.click(idx)

steps.analysis: This action is a global app launch with no element dependency, so element-index drift is irrelevant; the only requirements are that Markor is installed/launchable and that we wait for its main screen before the next step. It can fail if the app is missing or slow to start, so verify the Markor UI appeared after launching.
steps.snippet:
device.open_app("Markor")
device.settle(2)
if device.find(text="Markor") is None and \
   device.find(description="Create a new file or folder") is None:

steps.analysis: The action opens Markor's search dialog by tapping the toolbar item whose accessibility description is "Search"; it depends only on that description being present on the main screen, and breaks on other instances if the toolbar layout, index order, or description changes.
steps.snippet:
idx = device.find(description="Search", clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise LookupError("Toolbar 'Search' button not found on Markor main screen")

steps.analysis: The action depends on the note list item being identifiable by its description "File {file_name}" (indexes vary per instance); it can fail if the note isn't rendered on screen (needs scrolling) or if the exact description format differs.

steps.analysis: The click depends on the target note already being selected so a "Delete" option (by content-description) is present on the MainActivity screen; on another instance the index differs and the option may be missing if no note is selected or hidden in an overflow menu.
steps.snippet:
idx = device.find(description="Delete", clickable=True)
if idx is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Delete option not found - ensure the target note "
                       f"({binding.get('file_name')}) is selected first")
device.click(idx)
device.settle(1)  # wait for the Confirm Delete dialog

steps.analysis: The action depends only on Markor's "Confirm Delete" dialog being open (with the target file named in its message) and an 'OK' button to confirm; indexes may shift and the dialog message text varies per file, so we must verify the dialog names the bound file and locate 'OK' semantically.
steps.snippet:
file_name = binding["file_name"]
if device.find(contains=file_name) is None:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Delete confirmation dialog for '{file_name}' is not shown")
ok_index = device.find(text="OK", clickable=True)
